checkpoints.quote: The Data Protection warnings are present but they do not explain the observed failures. The log’s errors are SMTP 535 authentication failures.
checkpoints.reason: Analysis explicitly separates the routine DataProtection warnings from the SMTP failures and rejects the reporter's link.

checkpoints.quote: Review outbox retry logic: implement backoff and dead-lettering to prevent head-of-line blocking, as currently warned.
checkpoints.reason: Analysis notes the lack of backoff/dead-letter path and the head-of-line blocking effect matching item 991204's warning.
Analysis tracks the outbox backlog growth from 1412 to 2089, matching the expected trend.
The analysis never notes that the log begins at 18:02:41 (after restart) and that the previous container's log was not captured, so it cannot confirm the 14:00 outage start.

checkpoints.quote: pod restart at 18:02 did not help per Priya Nair comment at 18:45
checkpoints.reason: Analysis notes the prior restart failed and later reiterates 'Restarting will not fix authentication', tying the ongoing 535 errors after restart together.

checkpoints.quote: Check with Platform / Email Ops for any SMTP policy change or credential rotation around 14:00 today that disabled basic authentication.

checkpoints.quote: Check with Platform / Email Ops for any SMTP policy change or credential rotation around 14:00 today that disabled basic authentication.
